request.query: What are the UPI Lite transaction and total balance limits?

claims.text: The most recent limits for UPI Lite are a per-transaction limit of ₹1,000 and a total balance limit of ₹5,000 at any point in time.
Earlier provisions established lower limits, specifically a per-transaction limit of ₹200 with a total balance limit of ₹2,000.
A subsequent circular in 2023 increased the per-transaction limit to ₹500 while maintaining the total balance limit at ₹2,000.

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.

quotes.quote: 1. As per the latest notification issued by RBI on 4th December 2024 vide circular no. RBI/2021-22/146 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S1264/02-14-003/2021-2022 with subject ‘Framework for Facilitating Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, for UPI LITE, the enhanced limits shall be ₹1,000 per transaction with ₹5,000 being the total limit. Replenishment of used limit shall be allowed only in online mode with AFA. Customer will further have the option to set Auto Top-up for limit replenishment as per NPCI circular, ‘Introduction of Auto Top-up on UPI LITE’, vide No. NPCI/UPI/OC No. 205/2024-25, dated 27th August 2024. The details of the LITE limits are as below: | Description | UPI LITE — Existing | UPI LITE — New | UPI LITE X (Offline) — No Change | |---|---|---|---| | Per Transaction Limit | ₹500 | ₹1000 | ₹500 | | Total Limit at any point in time | ₹2000 | ₹5000 | ₹2000 | The new limits shall apply to and govern all existing NPCI circulars pertaining to UPI LITE limit (Annexure A). All the members are required to make the necessary changes pertaining to limit increase immediately.

quotes.quote: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500. The details are as below: | UPI LITE Limit | Previous Limit | New Limit | |---|---|---| | Per Transaction | ₹200 | ₹500 | | Max balance in UPI lite account | ₹2000 | ₹2000 (No change) | The existing UPI pricing shall be applicable for transaction amount ₹201-₹500 for both P2P and P2M transactions. With reference to the above, Member Banks (Payee PSP), Third Party App providers (TPAPs), Merchants and other payment providers are requested to take note of the above enhancement

sources.text: volumes. As an efficient strategy to process large-scale small value digital payments and based on the guidelines issued by RBI for enabling mobile devices to support offline payments vide its circular no. CO.DPSS.POLC.No. S1264/ 02-14-003/2021-2022 titled “Framework for facilitating small value digital payments in offline mode” dated 3rd January 2022, NPCI has designed the “UPI Lite – On-Device wallet” (“UPI Lite”) functionality for UPI user (User). In phase 1, UPI Lite will process transactions in near offline mode i.e. debit offline and credit online, and at a later point, UPI Lite will process transactions in complete offline mode i.e. debit and credit both offline. A User of UPI App will have the option to enable UPI Lite i.e. “On-Device wallet” on her/his UPI App. Once enabled, the User can allocate funds from her/his bank account to UPI Lite. Such funds shall reside with the User’s bank in an escrow / pool / designated account and such balance shall reside on-device on the common library (CL) of the User’s UPI App. At present, only debit from UPI Lite balance shall be permitted and all credits to UPI Lite (including refunds, etc.) will be processed online in the User’s bank account maintained in the bank’s core banking system. The upper limit of an UPI Lite payment transaction shall be ₹200/-.The total limit

sources.text: NPCI /UPI/OC No.138/2021-22 March 16, 2022 To, All UPI Member Banks Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of “On-Device wallet” – UPI Lite for Small Value Transactions UPI has become one of the most preferred digital payment mode for Indian citizens because of ease and convenience, superior user experience, security and interoperability. To realize the vision of billion-a-day payments within the next 3 to 5 years, NPCI has been aggressively innovating and adding new features in UPI from time to time to expand its usage. Various studies on payment systems have observed that about 75% of the total volume of retail transactions (including cash) in India are below ₹100 transaction value. Further, 50% of the total UPI transactions are having a transaction value of up to ₹200/-. To process billion-a-day transactions, entire UPI ecosystem will have to invest heavily in infrastructure upgrade. Large banks have already implemented upgrades, such as separate financial and meta transactions infrastructure, separate endpoints for payment service provider (PSP) / issuer and to provide better technical up time for UPI services, and such banks are getting ready to process three times of current volumes. As an efficient strategy to process large-scale small value digital payments and based on the guidelines issued by RBI for enabling mobile devices to support offline payments vide its circular no. CO.DPSS.POLC.No. S1264/ 02-14-003/2021-2022

This precaution is to ensure that any pending offline transactions are processed. If no such transactions are received (online) within this timeframe, the hold is lifted, and the balance is updated in the system with a specific response code on the Sth day.
